mesh_shifted_merged.notes: base mesh (~26k nodes); absorber centered at (0, 1mm, 0.56216mm)

mesh_refined_3x.notes: 3x refined (~63k nodes); recipe reconstructed after the fact, not re-verified against the existing directory

mesh_dual_base.notes: dual-TES base mesh (base resolution); single long absorber over two TES stacks at x=-tes_pitch/2 and x=+tes_pitch/2. Pinned to the original 5mm absorber / 4mm pitch experiment via parameter_overrides, independent of the project's global dabs_dx/tes_pitch defaults.

mesh_dual_20mm.notes: 20mm absorber, TES at x=±9.5mm (pitch 19mm), base resolution

mesh_dual_base_3x.notes: 3x-refined dual_tes (5mm absorber, 4mm pitch) -- test of L/R mesh-asymmetry convergence

mesh_dual_base_2x.notes: 2x-refined dual_tes (5mm absorber, 4mm pitch) -- test of L/R mesh-asymmetry convergence, direct-solver-tractable

mesh_dual_base_15x.notes: 1.5x-refined dual_tes (5mm absorber, 4mm pitch) -- interpolation point for L/R mesh-asymmetry convergence

mesh_dual_20mm_2x.notes: 2x-refined dual_tes (20mm absorber, TES at x=+/-9.5mm) -- L/R asymmetry reduction test

mesh_dual_base_localrefine.notes: local box refinement around TES_L/R+Stycast_L/R only (background mesh at 1x) -- cheap alternative to global 2x

mesh_dual_20mm_localrefine.notes: 20mm dual_tes with local TES-column refinement only (TES_LOCAL_REFINE_H env var required at build time) -- cheap alternative to global 2x

mesh_refined_3x_repart_x.notes: Validated 4-rank x partition; keeps nearly all non-conforming mortar pairs on the same rank.

mesh_singlepixel_conformal_gpu.notes: Independent all-tetra 3x shared-node experiment.  The three contact footprints are imprinted and face meshes are paired before ElmerGrid node merging; this route must pass the post-conversion connectivity gate.

mesh_singlepixel_conformal_gpu_fine.notes: Fine shared-node contact mesh targeting production-v2-like spatial resolution; generated independently from the Mortar production path.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_coarse_tail.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Matches COMSOL timestamps exactly through pulse+500 us, then keeps every 5th COMSOL sample to the COMSOL end time. A full-field checkpoint is written at stage 203 (pulse+500 us).

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_ringing_diag.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Restarts from the pulse+500 us checkpoint; 490 uniform 50 us steps to pulse+25 ms (ignores COMSOL's own sample times in this stretch), to check whether a small fixed step size removes the ringing seen with COMSOL-cadence or geometric-ramp steps.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_ringing_diag_10.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Restarts from the pulse+500 us checkpoint; 490 uniform 50 us steps to pulse+25 ms (ignores COMSOL's own sample times in this stretch), to check whether a small fixed step size removes the ringing seen with COMSOL-cadence or geometric-ramp steps.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_uniform_10.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Restarts from the pulse+500 us checkpoint; 1795 uniform 100 us steps to pulse+180000 us (ignores COMSOL's own sample times throughout), to remove the BDF1 ringing confirmed by case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_ringing_diag_100us. Checkpoint at step 897.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_uniform_50.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Restarts from the pulse+500 us checkpoint; 3590 uniform 50 us steps to pulse+180000 us (ignores COMSOL's own sample times throughout), to remove the BDF1 ringing confirmed by case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_ringing_diag. Checkpoint at step 1795.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_uniform_co.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Single continuous run (no restart mid-way): COMSOL's exact grid from t=0 through pulse+500 us, then 1795 uniform 100 us steps to pulse+180000 us. Combines the ringing fix (case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_ringing_diag_100us) with the checkpoint-seam fix in one run.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_uniform_ra.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Single continuous run (no restart mid-way): COMSOL's exact grid through pulse+500 us; fixed 4 us steps through pulse+1000 us; then a maximum-1.25x geometric ramp to 100 us and a 100 us uniform tail to pulse+180000 us. Isolates the pulse+655 us COMSOL-crossing sensitivity from the prior 4 us-to-100 us step jump.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_uniform_20.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Single continuous run: COMSOL-exact through pulse+500 us; 4 us through pulse+1000 us; a maximum-1.25x ramp to 20 us; 20 us through pulse+1995.37 us; then a maximum-1.25x ramp to 100 us and a 100 us tail through pulse+180000 us.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_coarse_tail_res.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Matches COMSOL timestamps exactly through pulse+500 us, then keeps every 5th COMSOL sample to the COMSOL end time. A full-field checkpoint is written at stage 203 (pulse+500 us).

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_tail.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Restarts from the pulse+500 us checkpoint, replays the pulse+500-600 us coarse tail, then keeps every 10th COMSOL sample out to COMSOL's own end time (pulse+180 ms). A full-field checkpoint is written at stage 4 (pulse+600 us).

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Single continuous run (no restart checkpoints) following every COMSOL timestamp from t=0 to COMSOL's own end time (200 ms absolute), with round-off-level pulse duplicates filtered at 1 us. Avoids the restart-boundary and coarse-tail artifacts seen in the checkpointed coarse_tail/full_tail chain.

case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full_smooth.solver_comment: max iterations 25: headroom for dt-stage boundaries where the coupling loop gain jumps

comparison_time_grid.description: Same as case_tes_mpi_comsol_grid_full, with pulse+9.98-19.98 ms replaced by a max-1.2x-growth geometric ramp between the same boundary timestamps (ignoring COMSOL's intermediate samples in that window), to remove the BDF1 step-doubling wiggle seen there without introducing a new jump at the window exit.
